title: Built a Slay the spire clone in 2 days
author: No-Aside7831
selftext:
wuxia focused slay the spire built with codex, imagegen and comfyui. 

  
hard part is always creating an additive gameplay loop. 

  
I think the synchronization of style of assets are more or less there for certain genre like this one.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: What did you do for the music? I'm going for this vibe too

replies.author: No-Aside7831
replies.body: I used a local music model but eleven labs and suno works as well

replies.author: kavakravata
replies.body: Wait, are there local music models these days?! What’s the name of it?

replies.author: No-Aside7831
replies.body: Out of all the ones I’ve tested the best one is acestep 1.5 turbo. It’s on huggingface

comments.author: HeadlessFrogMan
comments.body: Could you walk us through your asset creation pipeline for the art?

replies.author: AxlJones
replies.body: Imager or Imagen? Absolutely stunning results btw

replies.author: HeadlessFrogMan
replies.body: How did you use codex and imagen though, as in how did you use imagen to generate sprites with animations and such?

replies.author: No-Aside7831
replies.body: No there was no sprite you can tell because there isn’t any animation outside of basic movements

comments.author: s_a_m_12344
comments.body: The thing that lacks and makes it more obvious it was vibecoded is the lack of animations on the attacks, but very good job lol hands up great thing for 2 days

replies.author: alphapussycat
replies.body: That and the art is shit.

replies.author: s_a_m_12344
replies.body: I guess art could just even be placeholders as it can be easily replaced, if the logic works and is fine I think is a great work he did

replies.author: teamharder
replies.body: Thats the first thing I noticed as well. Nice setup otherwise.
you seem to have no clue about designing games

comments.author: MentalFairy95
comments.body: Do you also have a solution for more complex cards? E.g. power cards, relics which affect cards? Relics which trigger?

replies.author: No-Aside7831
replies.body: Every mechanics would require additional work for linking it to each such other. I would probably decompose it by adding in a post card play mechanic and a relic trigger mechanics that’s linked to each cards that’s played

comments.author: notq
comments.body:
I have done this as well. It has weeks of work. Probably over a month combined.

It takes a lot of detail getting everything right. But your map still looks better than mine, so bravo there.
its a joke to compare this with sts

comments.author: MichaelEmouse
comments.body: Please make a video of your process. At least a developer log.

comments.author: MejorSaludMental
comments.body:
Looks great man, now you only need animations, probably the hardest part

My friend was trying to make something similar, what tools did you use? 

Would you be open to share your code?

comments.author: Sea-Look1337
comments.body: The hard part is actually making a fun, interesting game design. Art, animations, coding, etc are all meant to be in service of that. Have you found an interesting design space that's meaningfully different than StS?

comments.author: game_plaza
comments.body: What was your workflow like? Im assuming you used Unity. Did you do the manual stuff in Unity Editor, like setting up the scenes and gameobjects or did agents handled that?

comments.author: -Takezo
comments.body: that's what i'm talking about! that's really cool man! only 2 days and you made it look like this? Man i'm sure if you put in more time and effort it's going to look really polished. Keep it up, i really enjoyed playing games like that, especially chaos zero nightmare

comments.author: eggs_mcmerlwin
comments.body:
I feel like we’ll see a flood of sts clones. Probably a testament to how loved it is. 

It’s the first thing i vibed, since the mechanics are so easy to replicate. Then you realize what makes it great isnt just the mechanics - its the art, animation, content, tuning, tlc, polish etc

comments.author: galactom
comments.body: Looks like slop, plays like slop. All AI can do is steal and clone, just like the user base.

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: This is the kind of thing that puts people off AI generated games. There's nothing stopping you from making a great game with AI but if you can churn it out in 2 days it's slop.

comments.author: bugbearmagic
comments.body: I think this is one of those art styles that sort of just works on a superficial level.  But the lack of polish with visuals keep it just a proof of concept.  The question is can you get it to the same production quality as slay the spire.

replies.author: No-Aside7831
replies.body: yeah i think if i have the time i can do alot more in progress.

comments.author: SadPlumx
comments.body: This is amazing. You did this in just 2 days? Are you a professional game developer?

comments.author: Regular-Dingo-2872
comments.body: its really good, even if you dont want to finishe the game you could release a 'slay the spire ' like template for people to use as a foundation
